```text
# #3315: Patch: follow-up to #3268 from the after-merge spot-check
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

<!-- jackioh-bot:spot-check-follow-up #3268 -->
The after-merge spot-check of #3268 ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42260849923)) found 1 blocking problem(s) in the change as it merged (`5afc00a43a9e`). `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) reviewed it. #3268 stays merged: nothing is reverted, and this issue fixes what it found in a change of its own, from `main`.

## What to fix

- [ ] `apps/web/src/game/FieldBadges.tsx:116`: Over a DEF card the stack's room is so short that the fold goes down to `room` -1 and draws no keyword mark and no `+N` either, so on a phone a DEF unit's keywords disappear from the board with no sign they exist (the README says the rest 'fold into +N').
  Evidence: board.css:3148-3151 caps a DEF stack at `(100cqh - field-card-w * def-scale) / 2 - 2px`. Using the zone and card sizes the plan measured (390x664: zone 65.6x60.4, card 49x57; 390x844: 65.6x94.8, 64x88; 360x780: 59.6x82.6, 58x80; 430x932: 73.6x113.8, 72x99), that cap works out to about 3.7, 21.5, 17.7 and 28.1px. The control is 16px tall (activate.css:141), a mark or the `+N` is 12px, and the gap is 2px (`--space-1`). So the control plus a `+N` (30px) fits at none of the four sizes. For a unit with Activate and keywords, `Stack` steps `room` down to -1, and `{unit != null && fit.room >= 0 && ...}` (FieldBadges.tsx:116) then renders no `.keywords` at all. At 390x664 even a DEF unit with no Activate (the opponent's, for example) gets nothing: one 12px item does not fit 3.7px. The face draws no marks either (`keywordsOffFace`). field-badges.test.tsx's '10px' case pins this ('draws no mark and no +n'), and board-layout.cy.tsx's DEF branch accepts `marks.length >= 1`, the control alone. Issue #3257 asks that marks that do not fit 'fold into the existing +N'. A possible fix: never drop the `+N` while a unit has a mark to draw, just as the control is never dropped. That needs a spec at 390x664 for a DEF unit with and without Activate.

## Done when

- Each finding above is fixed where it points, or answered with the evidence that it does not hold.
- Every check is green, with no test skipped, ignored or weakened to get there (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot from the after-merge spot-check (one in 5 medium or hard merges, `spot_check_every`): `claude-8` (`claude`) built #3268 and `claude-8` (`sonnet`) approved it. This issue's own pull request is never spot-checked.

<!-- jackioh-bot -->

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-3` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42262590434)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

A DEF unit on a phone must never lose its keyword marks without a sign. Today `Stack` in `FieldBadges.tsx` steps `fit.room` down to -1 when even the `+N` overflows the stack's `max-height`, and then draws no `.keywords` at all. Over a DEF card that cap is about 3.7, 21.5, 17.7 and 28.1px at the four phones, and the control plus a `+N` needs 30px, so the marks vanish.

The fix, as the finding proposes: while a unit has a mark to draw, the `+N` is never dropped, as the Activate control is never dropped. This holds with or without an Activate ability, at every phone size. Keep a jsdom test and a Cypress spec for it, including 390x664 with and without Activate.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/game/FieldBadges.tsx` | `change`: floor `fit.room` at 0, drop the `room >= 0` render guard and `Math.max`, update the comments |
| `apps/web/src/game/field-badges.test.tsx` | `change`: the `"10px"` case now expects the `+n`; an `activate` flag on `view`/`renderGame`; a new no-Activate DEF case |
| `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx` | `change`: the DEF branch of the #3257 spec lets the control and `+n` hang; a new per-size #3315 spec |
| `apps/web/README.md` | `change`: the paragraph at about lines 346-359 (the control is never dropped, and nor is the `+N`) |
| `apps/web/src/game/board.css` | `change`: the comment above `.board .zone:has(> .card[data-position="DEF"]) > .field-badges` (about lines 3139-3147) only, no rule |

Do not touch:
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`.
- Any crate, `spec/`, `catalog.json` or `apps/web/src/wire/`.
- The CSS rules themselves. `position-switch.test.tsx` pins them by regex and must stay green untouched.

No ruling is needed: this is presentation, not a rules decision, so no `spec/rulings/` note and no `spec/pending/` file. It changes no catalog and no card, so there is no patch fragment either. CLAUDE.md rules 7 and 9 hold as before: the component draws view data only, and the new code has no new number.

## Steps

1. `apps/web/src/game/FieldBadges.tsx`, in `Stack`:
   - Replace the comment above `const [fit, setFit]` with: `room` counts the named marks drawn, from the face's own cap down to 0, where the "+n" alone stands for every mark. The "+n" is never dropped while the unit has a mark to draw, as the control is not, so the measure stops at 0 even if it still overflows. A new object forces a measure.
   - In the first `useLayoutEffect`, change the guard `fit.room >= 0 && overflows(element)` to `fit.room > 0 && overflows(element)`.
   - Delete `const cut = Math.max(fit.room, 0);`. Use `const rest = chips.slice(fit.room);` and `chips.slice(0, fit.room)` in the map.
   - Change the render guard `unit != null && fit.room >= 0 && chips.length > 0` to `unit != null && chips.length > 0`.
2. `apps/web/src/game/FieldBadges.tsx`, header comment (lines 9-12): replace "The Activate control always stays." with a sentence saying the control and, while the unit has a mark to draw, the "+n" always stay. Where the room is shorter than they are (a DEF card on any phone), they hang over the turned card's top-left by the difference, which extends the owner's #3268 call on the control to the "+n". A named mark is drawn only where it fits.
3. `apps/web/src/game/board.css`: reword the DEF comment (lines 3144-3147) the same way. Write "the control and the +N" and put no `{` or `}` in the comment, because `position-switch.test.tsx` reads this sheet by regex.
4. `apps/web/README.md`: in the paragraph at about lines 346-359, replace "The Activate control is never dropped, so where that band is shorter than the control (a phone as short as 664px) the control overlaps the turned card's attack gem by the difference." with: the control is never dropped, and nor is the `+N` while the unit has a mark to draw, so a DEF unit's keywords never vanish with no sign. Where the band above the turned card is shorter than they are (about 4px at 390x664, 18 to 28px at the other phones) they overlap the turned card's top-left, its attack gem and the start of its name, by the difference. Also change "the same control, and only the marks that fit" to "the same control, the named marks that fit and a `+N` for the rest".
5. `apps/web/src/game/field-badges.test.tsx`:
   - Change `view(position)` to `view(position = "ATK", activate = true)`, with `activations: activate ? [PING] : []` on `b1`.
   - Change `renderGame(position = "ATK", activate = true)` to pass `activate` through.
   - Rewrite the third case of `describe("#3257 …")` as `"a stack with no room for a second item keeps the Activate control and the +n, and draws no named mark"`. With `stubLayout("10px")` it expects `keywordsOf()` to equal `[]`, `more()?.textContent` to be `"+2"`, `more()?.getAttribute("title")` to contain `"Rush"`, and the `.activate-control` to be present.
   - Add `describe("#3315 a DEF unit's keywords never vanish from the board", …)` with two cases:
     - A DEF unit with Activate: `stubPhonePortrait(true)`, `stubLayout("3.7px")`, `renderGame("DEF")`. Expect no named mark, the control present, and `+2` whose title contains `"Rush"` and `"Can't Defend"`.
     - A DEF unit without Activate: the same with `renderGame("DEF", false)`. Expect `document.querySelector(".field-badges .activate-control")` to be `null`, `keywordsOf()` to equal `[]`, `more()?.textContent` to be `"+2"`, and the stack still present.
   - Reuse the file's `restore` and `afterEach` pattern.
6. `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx`, the `#3257 … on and off DEF` spec (about lines 901-967):
   - Change `to.be.at.least(position === "ATK" ? 2 : 1)` to `to.be.at.least(2)`. Lanes 1, 3 and 5 hold both an ability and keywords, so DEF now holds the control plus a mark or the `+N`. Fix the comment above it.
   - Above the `marks.forEach`, add `const mayHang = (mark: HTMLElement): boolean => position === "DEF" && (mark === control || mark.matches(".cf-kw-more"));` with a comment citing `FieldBadges.tsx`. Replace the `if (mark === control && !controlFits) return;` line with `if (mayHang(mark)) return;`, so a named mark must still end above the limit.
   - Keep the `controlFits || (position === "DEF" && size.height === 664)` assertion, the inside-zone, switch, other-zone and corner checks, and the "same left and top as in ATK" block unchanged. Index 1 is under the control in both positions, so it still matches.
7. `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx`: inside `for (const size of SIZES)`, after the `#3257 marks that do not fit` spec, add a spec named `#3315 a DEF unit's keyword marks never vanish: the stack keeps a mark or the +n, with and without Activate, at ${where}`. Model it on that spec's `crowded` set-up:
   - Take `base.you.units[0]` as `first`, and throw as that spec does if it is null.
   - Define `check(withActivate: boolean)`. It builds `{ ...first, position: "DEF" as const, keywords: [{ kind: "Rush" as const }, { kind: "Can't Defend" as const }], activations: withActivate ? [PING] : [] }`. It replaces lane 1's unit in the view, mounts `Game` with `legal={[]}` inside `.app-shell.app-shell--wide`, and waits for `FIELD_CARDS` to have `FIELD_CARD_COUNT`.
   - In a `cy.document().should(...)` block, take `unitZone(doc, 1)` and its `:scope > .field-badges`, and assert:
     - the stack is non-null, and the card's `data-position` is `"DEF"`;
     - `.activate-control` is present if and only if `withActivate`;
     - `named = stack.querySelectorAll(".keyword-icon").length` plus the `+N` count parsed from `.cf-kw-more` (0 if absent) equals 2;
     - when `size.height === 664` the `.cf-kw-more` is non-null, since the band there is about 3.7px and no named mark fits;
     - every `MARKS` box is inside the zone box (left, top, right, bottom, with `SLACK_PX`), as the neighbouring specs assert.
   - End with `check(true); check(false);`.
8. Run the commands under Tests. If Cypress cannot start in the sandbox (the planner's attempt failed at the config with "Cannot find package '@vitejs/plugin-react'"), say so in the report and rely on `typecheck:component` and the geometry in step 6. Do not weaken or skip any assertion.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/game/field-badges.test.tsx`:
  - the rewritten `10px` case (control plus `+2`);
  - `#3315 … with Activate` (control plus `+2` at `3.7px`);
  - `#3315 … without Activate` (`+2` alone, no control);
  - all older cases unchanged. The `30.6px` case still draws no named mark and a `+2`.
- `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx`: the adjusted #3257 DEF spec and the new #3315 spec, at 390x844, 390x664, 360x780 and 430x932.

Commands:
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/field-badges.test.tsx src/game/position-switch.test.tsx` (the `pretest` builds the wasm module first).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
- `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component`
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/game e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx`
- `pnpm --dir e2e exec cypress run --component --browser chrome --spec cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx`, if it starts.

## Done when

- [ ] A DEF unit with marks draws the `+N` at every phone size, with and without Activate (finding fixed at `FieldBadges.tsx:116`).
- [ ] `fit.room` never goes below 0, and no test is skipped, ignored or weakened.
- [ ] The README, the `FieldBadges.tsx` header and the `board.css` comment match the behaviour.
- [ ] The vitest files, typecheck, eslint and `cargo fmt --check` pass. The harness's checks are green: web tests, and rulings, patches and catalog (all unaffected).
- [ ] The report names any check that could not run (the Cypress spec, if it failed to start).

## Risks

- **Overlap in DEF.** The `+N` now hangs over the turned card's top-left, as the control already does at 390x664 (the owner's #3268 call). At 390x664 it sits about 20-32px from the zone's top, over the attack gem and the start of the turned name plate. It stays inside the zone and takes no press (`pointer-events: none`). The Cypress spec lets only the control and `+N` hang in DEF, so a named mark still has to fit.
- **Layout loop.** The measure stops at `room` 0, so the layout effect cannot loop. The `ResizeObserver` still resets to `drawn` on a zone resize.
- **CSS pins.** The CSS rules are untouched, so `position-switch.test.tsx`'s regexes hold. Keep braces out of the changed comment.
- **Hidden information.** None: the component draws the same view data as before.

## Open questions

- Is the `+N` hanging over the turned DEF card's attack gem and name start acceptable, as the control's overlap is (the finding proposes it)? The alternative the builder did not take is a row layout in DEF, with the `+N` beside the control. That needs a design for the switch's reach and changes what the spec pins about marks' positions.
```
